scope: Study Butte utility; Brewster County grants and meetings; TWDB projects/plans/programs; groundwater district publications; selected regulatory records; targeted public portal records.
gaps: Not everything ever publicly released: county pre-2024 archives, CivicClerk attachments/videos and the courthouse environmental review record are not comprehensively captured.

County archive contains 45 image-only documents not fully searched. Some groundwater district PDFs and utility tariff/older CCR pages are also image-only. A search with no result is not proof of absence.

TCEQ wastewater technical package was identified through public search but original download failed. The Drinking Water Viewer shell is archived, not a complete export of current system results/violations.
IRS Form990 HTML reconstructions from ProPublica are archived for FY2023–2025; original XML/PDF endpoints were inaccessible. These are tax filings, not the separately referenced 2025 audit.

Actual TWDB 2024 and2025 water-use reports are archived, including raw intake and retail consumption. They do not establish current whole-system sustainable additional yield, treated production/reject volumes, treatment headroom or an expansion cost estimate. Raw intake minus retail is not a leakage estimate.
An environmental clearance, grant approval, agenda item and proposed schedule are different evidence states. None alone proves construction completion or spare capacity.
Aquifer conceptual-model presentation located; final technical report, supporting datasets, quantitative recharge budget and sustainable pumping analysis remain unverified.
Water-use surveys label the raw source Igneous Aquifer. Actual well logs must resolve the source formation before applying the Santa Elena conceptual model to utility yield.
TWDB mapped retail service area is not a parcel-level service promise or necessarily the legally certificated boundary. Portal query status fields are not compliance findings.
No organization contacted, records request filed, application submitted or commitment made. All saved material was publicly accessible at retrieval.
